failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What is the filming location of the horror movie R-Point, and where is it set? What is the relationship between Bokor Hill Station and Povokvil Waterfalls?' retrieves the exact same three core documents (Povokvil Waterfalls, Bokor Hill Station, R-Point) already returned in hop 1. The query re-asks questions already answered in summary_1.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What is the filming location of the horror movie R-Point, and where is it set? What is the relationship between Bokor Hill Station and Povokvil Waterfalls?' is formulated as a compound multi-part natural-language question bundling three separate targets (filming location, setting, geographical relationship).

failure_modes.name: Repetitive_Output_Loop
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states: 'R-Point is set in 1972 Vietnam (not Kenya) during the Vietnam War and was mostly filmed in Cambodia... Povokvil Waterfalls are located approximately 3 miles north-east of Bokor Hill Station, not south-west.' Summary_2 nearly identically restates: 'R-Point is set in 1972 Vietnam during the Vietnam War, not in Kenya. While it was partially filmed at Bokor Hill Station in Cambodia, the geographical relationship is incorrectly stated: Povokvil Waterfalls are located approximately 3 miles north-east of Bokor Hill Station.' Both summaries convey the same corrections without advancing toward any new verification goal.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents entirely irrelevant to R-Point (Longevity claims, Abell 1835 IR1916, Jerky, Stemming, Moloko Temo, Hryhoriy Nestor, Mounir Fourar, Dextronaut, Facebook Query Language, Domestic technology). The coordinator query for hop 3 was 'No additional query needed - the claim has been sufficiently verified as inaccurate,' yet the system executed retrieval anyway and returned unrelated documents that the agent would need to process.

failure_modes.name: Downstream_Handoff_Failure
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 coordinator reasoning states: 'No additional query needed - the claim has been sufficiently verified as inaccurate.' Yet the query field output is 'No additional query needed - the claim has been sufficiently verified as inaccurate' — a prose statement rather than a usable retrieval query. This breaks the expected format for the retrieval system, which then executed anyway and returned irrelevant documents.
